plausibility_notes: Confirmed cyanide death strengthens stolen-poison hypothesis but laboratory tests remain pending.
Artie leads on motive; Brie and Barb warrant attention on access. No clear accusation is justified.
An antique retaining lethal contents for over a century needs eventual explanation, though the condition report establishes the story premise.
